finding.title: Archive fsync failure after flush creates uncertain admitted rows with stale output generation
finding.source_mechanism: storage.append_observations writes complete JSONL records, flushes, then os.fsync. If fsync raises after flush, bytes can be visible in the current process although durable commit is uncertain; exception propagates. runner.run_once calls append before rebuilding history and before writing latest/audit/anata, so G0 outputs remain. On retry the already-visible observation ID can be deduplicated and appended_observations reported as zero while the archive had advanced during the failed call.
finding.deterministic_fixture: Seed tempfile local_dir with coherent G0 latest.json/audit_latest.json/anata_latest.json; create one valid FlowObservation X (and separate X,Y permutations) through local external_jsonl, fixed as_of_ms and network=False. Monkeypatch storage.os.fsync to raise OSError('injected archive fsync failure') only for the archive append after its flush, not while seeding G0. Inspect archive immediately after exception, then restore fsync and retry same rows; also retry with no external rows.
expected_assertions: Injected run_once raises OSError; archive may contain complete X while all three G0 outputs remain unchanged. Do not claim that fsync error proves bytes durable across a real power loss.
Archive admission and output generation must expose uncertain/incomplete commit state rather than silently treating G0 outputs as current.
Corrected retry yields exactly one X (and one Y in two-row permutations), strict-parseable JSONL, unchanged provenance and original available/observed clocks.
Post-recovery latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json agree on a single G1 snapshot; no stale or mixed generations.
Exact-duplicate retry adds zero rows; point-in-time visibility remains unchanged.
finding.distinct_from: 04:59 second-row to_dict TypeError, 09:00 nonfinite JSON, 11:00 interrupted newline: this failure occurs after ALL JSONL bytes are flushed but at the durability acknowledgement boundary; does not claim a crash durability outcome.
